name: Boolean Median Characterizes Flag Complexes
statement: For a finite abstract simplicial complex $\Delta\subseteq2^X$, the following are equivalent: $\Delta$ is flag; it is the clique complex, equivalently the independence complex, of a graph; and $\operatorname{med}(A,B,C)=(A\cap B)\cup(A\cap C)\cup(B\cap C)$ belongs to $\Delta$ for all $A,B,C\in\Delta$. Its face-poset covering graph is then a simplex graph and hence median.
comments: For $2^{\{1,2,3\}}\setminus\{\{1,2,3\}\}$, the three 2-faces have missing Boolean median $\{1,2,3\}$; its covering graph is $Q_3^-$ and is not simplex.
